name: Kakadu Plums (Gubinge)

description: Kakadu plums are an elite, hyper-potent botanical whole food matrix. Native entirely to the pristine Australian wilderness, this fruit commands the highest recorded natural concentration of Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) of any plant organism on Earth—up to 100 times that of traditional citrus. Fused with an advanced network of complex polyphenols like *ellagic* and *gallic* acids, it serves as an unparalleled dietary asset for deep cellular defense, collagen synthesis, and systemic free-radical eradication.

precautionsIntro: While the Kakadu plum functions as an unmatched botanical asset, its record-shattering vitamin concentration and highly active organic compounds require exact integration metrics.
precautions: Acute Gastric Ascorbate Clearance: Due to the monumental, unprecedented concentration of Vitamin C, consuming large quantities of raw Kakadu plums can rapidly overwhelm bowel absorption limits, triggering temporary osmotic diarrhea, abdominal cramps, or loose stool.

Extreme Sensitivity to Thermal Oxidation: The fragile water-soluble ascorbic acid matrix is highly prone to swift thermal destruction when exposed to cooking heat, boiling, or direct sunlight. Utilizing freeze-dried, unheated powder formats or raw fruit is required to preserve potency.

Soluble Oxalate Accumulation Balance: Kakadu plums carry a highly active organic acid profile containing natural oxalates. For individuals navigating a historical clinical baseline of calcium-oxalate kidney stones, intake volume must be managed to protect urinary filtration paths.

Extreme Post-Harvest Degradation: Because of the delicate wild nature of the fruit, its raw structural integrity decays rapidly post-harvest. Sourcing exclusively from highly verified, rapid freeze-dried supply chains or wild-harvested authentic channels is highly required.
